block.structured_extract.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.structured_extract.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.structured_extract.model.title: Structured Extract
block.structured_extract.model.descripti: Extract explicitly located fields from text or JSON, retaining evidence and validating the resulting schema.
block.structured_extract.help_input_form: text: one string; sections: array of referenced text sections; json: JSON Pointer extraction.
block.structured_extract.help_fields: Output fields and exact selectors: line_prefix, between or pointer. Ambiguous matches are never chosen silently.
block.structured_extract.help_schema: Supported JSON Schema subset. data is emitted only when the extracted object conforms; evidence/issues remain available.
block.structured_extract.help_max_bytes: Maximum input bytes. No file loading, network access or model calls.
block.structured_extract.help_max_field_: Maximum exact source span retained per field.
block.structured_extract.help_max_issues: Maximum published diagnostics; truncation is explicitly reported.
